about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Junior Frontend Developer • Computer Science Engineer & Current M.Sc. Student at UWM
about.paragraph1: I specialize in delivering interactive web applications using Vue.js, Angular, and React. As an engineering graduate and current Master's student in Computer Science at UWM Olsztyn (Computer Systems and Network Design), I ensure my solutions are not only visually polished and intuitive, but also secure and optimized in terms of network architecture.
about.paragraph2: Beyond frontend development, I work comfortably across backend technologies, databases, and AI/ML — building REST APIs in Python (FastAPI, Django) and PHP, containerizing apps with Docker, and developing deep learning models with PyTorch.
about.paragraph3: I am always open to new challenges and eager to take on ambitious projects, primarily as a Frontend Developer as well as in broader Fullstack and IT roles.
